test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 09 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

Try to be __frugal__ with your hard-earned money.
solution: The correct answer is option 2), i.e., 'Economical.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Let's look at the meaning of the given word: Word Meaning frugal being careful and thrifty in using resources, especially money. (मितव्ययी) • ​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options: Word Meaning Imprudent not showing care for the consequences of an action. (ढीठ) Economical giving good value or service in relation to the amount of money, time, or effort spent. (किफायती, मितव्ययी) Negligent failing to take proper care in doing something. (लापरवाह) Honest free of deceit and untruthfulness; sincere.. (ईमानदार) • Clearly, the word 'Economical' is closest in meaning to the given word 'frugal.' • Therefore, the correct synonym of the given word is option 2. 17d:T1441,
